description: This file contains an Android Activity class 'FragmentStack' which manages a stack of fragments. It provides functionality to add and remove fragments dynamically, displaying fragment instances with numbered labels. The class includes methods for handling UI interactions and fragment lifecycle, along with an inner static class 'CountingFragment' for individual fragment instances that display their assigned number.

classes.name: FragmentStack
classes.description: An Android Activity managing a stack of fragments with UI controls to add or remove fragments.

classes.name: CountingFragment
classes.description: An inner static Fragment class that displays its number and can be instantiated with a number argument.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity, including button click listeners and initial fragment setup.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current stack level state.

methods.name: addFragmentToStack
methods.description: Adds a new CountingFragment instance to the activity's fragment stack, incrementing the stack level.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new CountingFragment with its number argument.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieving its number argument.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the fragment's UI, inflating a layout and setting text and background.
